pages.title: Magnetar Shard
pages.text: A fragment of a magnetar, a neutron star with a magnetic field a thousand trillion times stronger than Earth's. Near it, atoms are stretched into needles and empty space becomes birefringent. It would wipe a credit card from the Moon, and it pulls iron from across the room.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Through the Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector I reached toward a magnetar and caught a shard. Dilithium Crystal and Sterile Neutrino kept the field from tearing it apart on the way back.
